cards.card_text: Then he turns to you, the listener: surely God will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly plague.
cards.verse_text: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
cards.snippet: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

cards.card_text: What does David say Israel escaped like?
cards.verse_text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
cards.snippet: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.

cards.card_text: No sleep for the eyes, no slumber for the eyelids, and the writer says to get free like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
cards.verse_text: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
cards.snippet: …hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

cards.card_text: Among His people are wicked men, and they watch like fowlers lying in wait.
cards.verse_text: For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait; they set a trap to catch men.
cards.snippet: For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait; they set a trap to catch men.

cards.card_text: Yet 'the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths.'
cards.verse_text: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman, along with my God, yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths.
cards.snippet: …is Ephraim’s watchman, along with my God, yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths.
